sources.summary: Rangunia Residence reinterprets the spatial and environmental principles of rural Bangladeshi architecture through a contemporary home shaped by climate, landscape, and everyday life. Located within the semi-rural setting of Rangunia, Chattogram, the house draws from familiar vernacular elements—not as nostalgic references, but as practical responses to place.
